leadText:
Otori Mountain (Japanese: オオトリ山 Mt. Ōtori) is an -exclusive location in Kalos that was featured in The Legend of the Ninja Hero! and A Festival of Decisions!. It served as the base for a group of ninjas led by Kagetomo. It is located between Anistar City and Couriway Town.

After kidnapping , Kagetomo, Heidayu, and their ninja army fled to Otori Mountain where Kagetomo announced his plans of attempting to succeed Hanzo as the chief of the Ninja Village instead of Ippei. While , , Shinobu, and the ninjas of the village took on Kagetomo's ninja army, Ippei and Saizo went to Otori Mountain to rescue Hanzo. Arriving there, Ippei had a battle with Kagetomo and emerged victorious. Ash's group met up with Ippei and Saizo after they defeated the ninja army.
